notes.title: Small update - Bugs fixed
notes.content:
[h3]Bugs changed in this version: [/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a collision bug in some enemy attacks that made them ignore walls.
[*] Fixed a crash when hit by the boss dagger attack
[*] Fixed the boss teleport particles that remained in place after the teleport ended.
[*] Fixed a bug that made the boss don't teleport when using the daggers
[*] Now you can hold E button to keep attacking instead of press it to every attack
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1.0 - QoL Update
notes.content: [h3]QoL and UI:[/h3][list][*][p]Texts that mention "meelee attacks" have been [b]changed to[/b] [b]"auto-attacks"[/b] to make it more intuitive.[/p][/*][*][p]Now the [u]cursor changes[/u] when accessing the settings to make it clearer that the [b]mouse scroll is used[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][u]Settings[/u] can also be [b]changed with the mouse click[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][u]Dialogs[/u] can now be advanced by [b]pressing space[/b] or with the [b]mouse click[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The Current [b]Floor / Wave UI [/b]was reworked so it won't overlap with the player's health bar anymore.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixing:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that made the final boss attacks still move and deal damage with the game paused.[/p][/*][*][p]The final boss pursuit animation was freezed into the first frame, now the animation runs normally.[/p][/*][*][p]The starting tutorial was sometimes skipped after selecting your dinosaur, giving some players the impression that there was no tutorial at all. This was fixed and now the tutorial will be played at the start of every run. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual glitch that made enemy spawn animation run with the game paused.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that made some achievements be unobtainable and achievements be erased.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue which made possible to reroll items for free when opening the summary after getting the 3 items from the shop.[/p][/*][*][p]The game remained in English even when Español as selected as the game language. The localization now works properly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Developer Notes:[/h3][p][/p][p]Most of these changes were reports and suggestions from players who talked directly to me about them. If you have something to tell me about the game or want to talk to other players, you can join our official Discord server[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 1.1.2
notes.content:
Hello! DTA Dev here, with another update for the free demo.

[h2] - This time, we have: [/h2]

[list]
[*] There was an exploit that made possible to continue a run after dying - Fixed
[*] The max combo info was being uploaded wrongly at the leaderboard - Fixed
[*] Accessing the summary with venom orb equipped made the game crash - Fixed
[*] Nerfed minmi (spiked enemy) - More info bellow
[/list]

[h2]Minmi nerf: [/h2]

[list]
[*] Minmi damage was reduced from 10% of the player max hp to 8%.
[*] Now there is a delay between it's multi-direction shots.
[*] Slowing them down will now increase the delay between their common shots.
[*] The speed of their spikes was reduced.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hey, DTA Dev here, and i'm announcing the first update of the Demo Version of the game! In this version, we have a new feature and a lot of bugs solved, yay! Bellow we have the list with everything that was changed with this update:

[h2]Combos added:[/h2]

A new scoring feature, combos, where added to the game: Everytime you deal damage to an enemy, if you hit it again shortly after, you start a combo, which will increase with another hit.
A combo works as a score multiplier, As your combo gets higher, the score got with each hit
will also increase.

[h2]The following errors are solved in this version: [/h2]

[list]
[*] Cursor disappeared after dying - Fixed
[*] The game crashed when restarting after death - Fixed
[*] Buying the Venom Orb upgrade gave the Fire Ball upgrade instead - Fixed
[*] Venom orb didn't appear randomly at the shop after unlocking it - Fixed
[*] Bugged attack icons appearing after accessing the attack summary - Fixed 
[*] The profile pictures at the leaderboard were show at a very low quality - Fixed
[*] Score counting as 0 after winning the game - Fixed
[*] Attack interval appearing aways as 1 second at the summary - Fixed
[*] Regeneration effect working when the game is paused - Fixed
[*] "New highscore" popup making the game crash - Fixed
[/list]

This version also brings these small changes:

[list]
[*]  Ceratosaurus shot damage adjusted
[*]  Now slowing down the ceratosaurus (red enemy) will delay their shots
[*]  Pteranodon attack increase per level reduced - +33 -> +18
[*]  Now the leaderboard is accessible from the main menu
[*]  Leaderboard interface reworked
[/list]
